name: com.ciopages/ciopages
title: CIOPages
description: Buyer Guides, product comparisons, market briefs and vendor profiles for enterprise IT buyers.

tools.name: find_buyer_guide
tools.description: Finds CIOPages Buyer Guides for an enterprise software category, such as "privileged access management" or "CRM". Returns each guide's title, summary, last update and URL. Use get_buyer_guide to read one.

query.description: The software category or buying question.

tools.name: get_buyer_guide
tools.description: Returns a CIOPages Buyer Guide's executive summary, what to evaluate, the vendor table (approach and best fit for each vendor) and the questions to ask vendors, with the guide's URL.

guide.description: The guide's slug from find_buyer_guide, such as "privileged-access-management".

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Returns a CIOPages side-by-side comparison of two products, such as "Snowflake" and "Databricks": when to choose each, five or six aspects compared, and the sources for every fact. Lists the available comparisons when there is no exact match.

tools.name: vendor_profile
tools.description: Returns a vendor's CIOPages Directory profile: what it does, its main capabilities, who it serves, where it is based and the profile URL.

tools.name: state_of_play
tools.description: Returns the latest CIOPages State of Play edition for a market: what the technology is, the state of the market, and its sources.

topic.description: The market, such as "zero trust network access".

tools.name: rfp_sample_questions
tools.description: Returns up to 10 RFP questions for a software category from a CIOPages RFP package, each with why it matters, what a good answer shows and the red flags. Needs a free CIOPages account with a work email.

guide.description: The Buyer Guide slug or category, such as "crm-platform" or "CRM".
